headline: Extension of Order of Conditions for MECO Substation #1 on Merrimack Street, plus a Notice of Intent for 264-272 Lowell Street.
summary: The commission will review an extension for an Order of Conditions at Merrimack Street and South Canal, Substation #1, filed by Andrew Cole for MECO. It will also address a Notice of Intent for 264-272 Lowell Street and adjacent parcels, filed by Civil Design Consultants Inc. for Rayprogress, LLC, which has been continued to October 15, 2026.
items: Order of Conditions-Extension, DEP File No. 195-0216, Merrimack Street and South Canal, Substation #1, Applicant: Andrew Cole for MECO, Owner: Mass Electric Co.
